claim_decisions.statement: UNDP's selected Chiúre–Mecúfi–Pemba sample reports Cyclone Kenneth impacts alongside weak housing/sanitation and displacement-related vulnerability.
claim_decisions.uncertainty: 2023 fieldwork discussing the 2019 cyclone; not representative of all Cabo Delgado. The temporal meaning of 'already displaced' is not independently established, so that inference is omitted.

gaps: Main verified the original UNICEF mobile-team wording and UN community-plan release. Planned community actions and security-constrained general services are not promoted to evaluated adaptation/peace outcomes.
Cabo Delgado sample evidence is historical and site-selected; cyclone damage, northern conflict displacement and Sofala climate displacement are kept separate.

executive_assessment.text: Selected Cabo Delgado sites, Nampula cyclone impacts and separately identified displacement drivers add local detail without merging weather and conflict causes.
Nankumi, Naminawe and Metula planning identifies equitable land/resource governance needs. Evaluation and government reports add capacity evidence, with implementation and causal limits retained.
